summary: Check scenario modes for every CSF loaded by kit Storybook, including app stories

replay.detail: No deployed replay or runtime data change.

compatibility.detail: Storybook and scenario checks share one CSF inventory. Ten existing undeclared app stories are pinned in a separate shrink-only deferral owned by fractal-web-app; new stories must declare modes and declared or removed entries must leave the list. App CSFs receive the runtime import-graph check. Documented Vite asset queries resolve existing base files as leaves without bypassing forbidden fixture paths. Existing blocked-PR debt and exemption pins are unchanged. This development-only change does not alter deployed protocols.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
